setup: An arc of the circle subtends a central angle of \([[central]]\) degrees, and an inscribed angle subtends the same arc.

steps.say: The inscribed-angle theorem relates the two: an angle with its vertex on the circle is half the central angle standing on the same arc.
Halving \([[central]]\) gives \([[angle]]\). The same theorem is why an angle inscribed in a semicircle is a right angle, since the central angle there is 180 degrees.

answer: So the inscribed angle is \([[angle]]\) degrees.
